# Golden transcripts

- `guidance-talent-garden-bocconi.txt`: what the hackathon's Python engine said during a simulated walk from Talent Garden to Bocconi University, at 1.3 m/s with GPS noise (from `server-py/tests/`, commit `ed9c4bf`).

Transcripts of the route rehearsal (plan card MOT-2) will live here too, one file per route: the whole sequence of what Milo says, compared word for word in the tests. The method comes from Soundscape-Android (research report N).
